snippet.title: Virtual Villagers: The Tree of Life Trailer
snippet.description:
Download Free: http://www.gamefools.com/pc-games/virtual-villagers-the-tree-of-life.html

Life on Isola begins to fade in Virtual Villagers: The Tree of Life. A worried chief sends a small expedition to the island’s hidden eastern shore, where a dying banyan stands beside a new village clearing. Choose the first settlers, then guide them through daily work as they gather food, raise children, build huts, study, and learn the skills needed to survive. Every task feeds the bigger mystery, from repairing water flow to opening paths, studying strange plants, and caring for the wounded Tree of Life.

Virtual Villagers: The Tree of Life turns each villager into part of a living plan. Farmers, builders, scientists, healers, and parents grow stronger through use, while the tribe keeps working even when attention shifts away. Island puzzles ask the right hands at the right moment, rewarding patient planning with new resources, rescued creatures, and deeper pieces of Isola’s past. Restore the tree, revive the fading island, and give the castaways a future rooted in the oldest corner of their home.
